description: Scroll the mouse wheel on the peer. Positive delta_y scrolls up, negative delta_y scrolls down. One wheel notch is typically 120. Optional x/y positions the scroll target first.

delta_x.description: Horizontal wheel delta. Positive scrolls right, negative left.

delta_y.description: Vertical wheel delta. Positive scrolls up, negative down.

from_screenshot.description: Set true when x and y were read from the last jrd_remote_screenshot picture. They are scaled to the remote screen for you.

x.description: Optional X coord for the scroll target.

y.description: Optional Y coord for the scroll target.

name: jrd_mouse_scroll
